summary: The promoted adapter significantly improves factual future SSIM but regresses factual flow EPE and both primary wrong-action margins, so the frozen action audit fails and no action-control/SOTA promotion is made.
evidence: The audit is decision-eligible with 20 independent physical episodes, one task, one inference seed, and 10,000 bootstrap iterations.
Factual future SSIM rises from 0.852103 to 0.864253; oriented gain is +0.012150 with 95% lower bound +0.009287.
Factual flow EPE changes from 1.749200 to 1.759784 pixels; lower-is-better oriented gain is -0.010584 with lower bound -0.024289.
Wrong-action SSIM margin changes from +0.001349 to -0.003368; gain -0.004717 and lower bound -0.008530.
Wrong-action flow-EPE margin changes from -0.011021 to -0.024267; gain -0.013246 and lower bound -0.032644.
lessons: Greater factual image similarity and action-effect pixel MAD do not establish correct action use.
A larger independent-episode suite reverses the apparent action-sensitivity optimism from smaller diagnostics.
limitations: Only wipe_table and seed 42 are represented.
Wrong-action rollouts have no physical target and remain diagnostic.
Conditioning is realized absolute EEF state rather than low-level command.
next_actions: Complete seeds 314159 and 20260811 and aggregate seeds before physical-episode bootstrap.
Do not promote the adapter for action control.
